dedupe_keys.name: nve open dataset for power market modelling fram demo dataset

description: This is an open data set for power market modelling of Northern Europe, published by the Norwegian Water Resources and Energy Directorate (NVE) to demonstrate its FRAM modelling framework and the open-source JulES power market model. It was built only from open sources, mainly ENTSO-E, NVE and PyPSA, and NVE invites feedback and contributions. The demo documentation uses it to simulate the 2023 power system over weather years 1995 to 1997, with Northern Europe at price-area level and aggregated hydropower, a variant with detailed Nordic hydropower, and cases with Norwegian demand raised by 20%. Countries modelled endogenously are Norway, Sweden, Finland, Denmark, the Netherlands, Germany, the UK, Poland, Lithuania and Estonia, with Latvia, France, Belgium, Switzerland, Austria, Czechia and Slovakia as exogenous neighbours. The data are a ZIP of about 397 MB with a changelog on Zenodo (version 0.2, December 2025) under CC-BY-4.0 at no cost, downloaded automatically by the demo scripts. Caveats: NVE describes it as a work in progress, and aggregated hydropower simplifies the Nordic system. Simulation uses are power market and hydropower scheduling simulation and capacity studies. Related records: none linked on the provider's pages read on the day.
